mapper.sql: case when p.del_flag='2' then least(coalesce(p.actual_end_date,p.plan_end_date,date(coalesce(deletion.deletedAt,p.update_time))), date(coalesce(deletion.deletedAt,p.update_time))) else coalesce(p.actual_end_date,p.plan_end_date) end
mapper.select: select p.project_id projectId,p.project_no projectNo,p.project_name projectName, p.main_owner_user_id ownerUserId,p.main_owner_name ownerName,p.base_currency currency, p.status projectStatus,p.accounting_state accountingState,p.delivery_policy_version deliveryPolicyVersion, p.version projectVersion,p.del_flag projectDelFlag, date_format(p.plan_start_date,'%Y-%m-%d') planStartDate, date_format(p.actual_start_date,'%Y-%m-%d') actualStartDate, date_format(,'%Y-%m-%d') projectEndDate, date_format(p.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d') recordedDate, m.user_id userId,m.user_name userName,m.member_role memberRole, date_format(m.joined_date,'%Y-%m-%d') joinedDate,date_format(m.left_date,'%Y-%m-%d') leftDate from ( select project_id,user_id,user_name_snapshot user_name,member_role,joined_date,left_date from biz_project_member where status='0' or left_date is not null union select project_id,user_id,user_name,member_role,joined_date,left_date from biz_project_member_cost_period ) m join biz_project p on p.project_id=m.project_id and p.cost_policy_version='MEMBER_DAYS_V1' left join (select project_id,min(create_time) deletedAt from biz_project_event where event_type='DELETE' group by project_id) deletion on deletion.project_id=p.project_id where (#{userId} is null or m.user_id=#{userId}) and (#{projectId} is null or p.project_id=#{projectId}) and (p.del_flag='0' or (p.del_flag='2' and coalesce(deletion.deletedAt,p.update_time) is not null)) and coalesce(m.joined_date,p.plan_start_date)<=#{dateTo} and (m.left_date is null or m.left_date>=#{dateFrom}) and coalesce(p.plan_start_date,p.actual_start_date)<=#{dateTo} and (() is null or ()>=#{dateFrom}) order by p.project_id,m.user_id,m.joined_date
mapper.update: update biz_project_staff_allocation set status='VOID',version=version+1,update_by=#{operator},update_time=now() where allocation_id=#{allocationId} and status='ACTIVE' and version=#{version}

update biz_project set actual_start_date=#{startDate},version=version+1,update_by=#{operator},update_time=now() where project_id=#{projectId} and version=#{version} and del_flag='0' and coalesce(accounting_state,'OPEN')='OPEN'
mapper.select: select count(*) from biz_project_daily_result where project_id=#{projectId} and is_current='1' and close_status='CLOSED' and biz_date between #{dateFrom} and #{dateTo}
